title: Fast Performance, Built-In
desc: Dovecot is engineered for speed. By leveraging advanced indexing and intelligent caching out-of-the-box, it delivers elite performance and lightning-fast response times without requiring complex manual tuning.

title: Standards Compliance
desc: Dovecot isn’t just compliant—it’s the benchmark. Through exhaustive testing and continuous community feedback, we ensure full adherence to the rigorous standards required to power a modern email server.

title: Self-Optimizing
desc: Dovecot’s metadata and indexes are self-optimizing. They adapt in real-time to provide exactly what the client needs—no more and no less.

title: Self-Healing
desc: Dovecot is designed to be resilient. It proactively identifies and repairs common issues — like corrupted index files — on the fly. While the system handles the fix, everything is logged in detail, giving you total visibility into the "why" without the emergency.

title: Security Focused
desc: Security is engineered into Dovecot’s core through a strict multi-process architecture that isolates tasks, ensuring that a vulnerability in one component cannot compromise the entire system.

title: Modular Architecture
desc: Dovecot is designed for flexibility. The robust plugin system allows you to easily extend functionality — whether you're adding new commands, modifying existing behaviors, or introducing support for custom mailbox formats. Tailor your server to your exact specifications.

title: Logging and Telemetry
desc: Get deep insights into your server's health via sophisticated logging and real-time event emission. From pinpointing rare edge cases to monitoring traffic patterns, Dovecot delivers the high-fidelity data you need to run your system with total confidence.

title: Powerful Mail Filtering
desc: Through the integrated Pigeonhole project, Dovecot provides comprehensive server-side filtering using the standardized Sieve language. Users can securely sort, forward, and automate responses along with managing this filtering using standardized remote protocols.

title: Fast Full Text Search
desc: Dovecot’s integrated Full-Text Search integration provides instant message body and substring searches without complicated or confusing setup.
